channel.title: K C B Inc - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from K C B Inc (kcbs.com)

item.title: Hugh Hefner's widow alleges his foundation stored thousands of sexual photos of women, "possibly girls"
item.description: Crystal Hefner says she was removed from her position as president of the Hugh M. Hefner Foundation after raising concerns over the "Playboy" founder's scrapbooks.

item.title: 4 dead in crash on Colorado highway involving dozens of vehicles, State Patrol says
item.description: The Colorado State Patrol says four people were killed in a crash on I-25 south of Pueblo involving at least 30 vehicles during what are being called "brownout" conditions with low visibility on Tuesday morning.

item.title: Kristi Yamaguchi says it's "imperative" for figure skaters to have a clean short program
item.description: Alysa Liu, Amber Glenn and Isabeau Levito, collectively known as the "Blade Angels," began their Olympic medal campaigns in women's figure skating on Tuesday.

item.title: Trump administration appeals judge's order to restore slavery exhibits
item.description: The Trump administration filed an appeal after a judge ordered slavery exhibits that were removed from the President's House Site to be returned.

item.title: Judge blocks deportation of Palestinian activist who led protests at Columbia
item.description: An immigration judge has dismissed the Trump administration's deportation case against Mohsen Mahdawi, a Palestinian graduate student and Columbia protest leader.

item.title: How "signal sniffer" technology is being used in the search for Nancy Guthrie
item.description: The "signal sniffer" being used in the Nancy Guthrie investigation was mounted on a helicopter on Monday.

item.title: 2/17: CBS Evening News
item.description: Blinding dust storm leads to deadly pileup on Colorado highway; The "crying horse" toy taking over China's internet

item.title: Pawtucket hockey game shooting victims identified as family members
item.description: Police in Pawtucket, Rhode Island said they are still searching for motive following Monday's deadly mass shooting at a high school hockey game, but said it was an attack targeting family members.

item.title: 2/17: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: Civil rights leader Jesse Jackson dies at 84; U.S. women's figure skating seeks first gold in 24 years.

item.title: 9 skiers still missing near California's Lake Tahoe after avalanche
item.description: A group of 15 backcountry skiers was reportedly involved in the incident, the sheriff's office says. Nine remain unaccounted for.
